appEphemeralPubKeyHash.description: hash160 of the ephemeral public key the app put in its connect request; identifies the request

walletEphemeralPubKey.description: The wallet's compressed ephemeral public key; the app derives the shared secret from it and its own ephemeral private key

encryptedPayload.description: The granted private keys encrypted to the app: a 28-byte envelope plus 32 bytes per key, one to seventeen keys (the session key plus up to eight bindings with both purposes)

loginKeyResponse.description: A wallet's response after approving a login request. The flat entry is keyed by the request hash and wallet identity, so other identities cannot block its write. On re-login the wallet deletes its previous response by values and creates a response for the new request.
